about: Build step 5.3 stage A1-1 (N8): the check ids of the step-5 graders whose VACUOUS result (n < floor: too few samples to say anything) may PASS the verdict, each with its reason. Every other VACUOUS check FAILS the verdict (`grader_checks.verdict`); the evidence still prints a waived check as `[VACUOUS] (WAIVED)`, never PASS. A waiver without a reason, or for an id that is no check, refuses the import of `grader_checks.py`. A waiver covers VACUOUS only: a waived check that judged a sample and found it wrong still FAILS. Hashed into the ledger's numbers by stage A1-3. (A1 fix round, 2026-10-23, the coordinator's ruling F1: the two absence guards below; nothing else is waived.)

R5.LEFT_NOT_NEW.reason: An ABSENCE guard: it judges each 'a new place' look-around draw made on a map the game had the player stand on earlier in the run (n = the draws judged), and a run with no such draw has nothing to judge and cannot breach it. The look-around draw is the AI's optional choice, so a healthy sweep in which the AI never drew one must not fail on it (the 5.3 A1 development smoke, seeds 1301-1302: 0 draws in 6 healthy runs). Waived so that typing the check changes no outcome (spec A1: 'A1 changes NO outcome'); n stays the honest count of draws judged. Stage B decides whether a sweep must exercise such draws (a coverage requirement) and then removes this waiver.

R5.CH2_NEW_PLACE.reason: An ABSENCE guard: it judges each chapter-2 'a new place' look-around draw against the maps chapter 1's GAME screen had the player stand on (n = the draws judged), and a run with no such draw has nothing to judge and cannot breach it. The look-around draw is the AI's optional choice, so a healthy sweep in which the AI never drew one must not fail on it. Waived so that typing the check changes no outcome (spec A1: 'A1 changes NO outcome'); n stays the honest count of draws judged. Stage B decides whether a sweep must exercise such draws (a coverage requirement) and then removes this waiver.
